title: CAN Bus Diagnostic Tool
subtitle: A hardware interface and Python GUI for live CAN monitoring
pitch: A custom hardware interface between a CAN bus and a computer, with a Python GUI for real-time monitoring, message filtering, and automated diagnostics.
highlights: Custom hardware interface built on an STM32 and an Arduino Uno
Python GUI for real-time monitoring, message filtering, and automated diagnostics
Documented the protocol and wrote user manuals

blocks.md: The tool is a custom hardware interface (STM32 and Arduino Uno) between a CAN bus and a computer, with a Python GUI for real-time monitoring, message filtering, and automated diagnostics. I documented the protocol and wrote user manuals for multiple designs. It is validated on the bench.
